hero.title: Value Propositions
hero.body: A complete view of what Cura delivers — from first claim intake to final payout and operational insight.

sections.title:
Passenger-facing
touchpoints & intake
sections.intro: Nine capabilities that shape how passengers file, experience, and resolve their claim.

cards.title: Claim Intake — PSS Integration
cards.body: Passenger and booking data are automatically retrieved from the airline's reservation system, eliminating manual entry errors. Invalid, duplicate, and fraudulent claims are stopped before they enter the compensation workflow — reducing abuse by claim agencies and creating a faster filing experience for genuine passengers.

cards.title: Verify Every Passenger
cards.body: Each passenger in a claim must confirm their participation before it proceeds. Reduces unauthorized claims and agency abuse — and gives airlines an early window to offer credits before passengers turn to third parties.

cards.title: Intelligent Claiming
cards.body: Claim types are dynamically enabled or restricted based on known flight and passenger data. Passengers receive instant feedback while filing — deterring ineligible submissions and reducing total claim volume before cases even open.

cards.title: Let Passengers Be Heard
cards.body: Every claim includes an optional space for passengers to share their story. Airlines gain direct insight into pain points and service failures — without adding workload to claims teams.

cards.title: Guide Toward Realistic Compensation
cards.body: When requested amounts differ significantly from expected compensation, passengers receive clear guidance about applicable regulations and available alternatives — resulting in better-informed submissions and faster resolution.

cards.title: Keep Passengers Informed
cards.body: Automatically communicates next steps, expected processing times, and claim status updates throughout the resolution journey. Giving passengers transparency and self-service access significantly reduces avoidable customer support interactions while improving the overall experience.

cards.title: Smart Compensation Offers
cards.body: Airlines can offer travel credits, vouchers, or loyalty miles instead of cash at any stage. A win-win: passengers receive greater perceived value while airlines reduce compensation costs and increase future bookings.

cards.title: Retaining Loyalty with Goodwill
cards.body: When a claim isn't eligible for compensation, airlines can still offer discount codes, travel vouchers, or bonus miles — turning a potentially negative experience into a retention and future booking opportunity.

cards.title: Automated Payment Collection
cards.body: Required payment details are collected and validated automatically at the right stage of the journey — eliminating back-and-forth and reducing processing delays on the final payout.

sections.title:
Back-office power
& operational insight
sections.intro: Six capabilities that automate operations, ensure compliance, and surface actionable data.

cards.title: End-to-End Claims Automation
cards.body: Airlines can automate end-to-end handling or only selected steps while keeping manual oversight where needed. Unlike systems that rely on AI to make decisions, Cura uses deterministic workflows based on airline policies, regulations, and business rules — so every claim is handled consistently, transparently, and compliantly.

cards.title: Purpose-Built for Airline Claims
cards.body: Passenger, booking, flight, disruption, communication, and document data in one platform. Eligibility can be assessed once at the flight level and automatically applied across all related claims — eliminating system switching and reducing investigation time.

cards.title: Automated Regulatory & Legal Responses
cards.body: When transportation authorities or legal representatives request information, Cura can automatically gather evidence, consolidate case history, and prepare a complete response package — with optional agent review before submission.

cards.title: AI-Powered Claim Assistance
cards.body: AI analyzes receipts, invoices, and baggage images, detects fraud, drafts communications, and recommends actions — while keeping airlines fully in control of decisions, compliance, and customer outcomes.

cards.title: Monitor & Act on Customer Sentiment
cards.body: Monitors social media and review platforms to identify passenger concerns and reputation risks. AI categorizes mentions, analyzes sentiment, and enables teams to convert public complaints into actionable claims — directly from the platform.

cards.title: Turn Claims Data into Operational Insight
cards.body: Airline-specific reporting across claims, operations, customer experience, and compensation costs. Teams can track claim volumes, processing performance, and disruption trends — while AI-powered analytics uncover patterns, detect anomalies, and recommend areas for operational improvement. Data that is impossible to get from disconnected systems.
